Karnataka launches cloud seeding to combat drought

Karnataka has launched cloud seeding operations at a cost of Rs 28.5 crore to address a rainfall deficit and avert a water crisis. The operation involves special aircraft, one of which was flagged off from HAL airport in Bengaluru. The state is facing drought conditions, prompting this measure.
